Purpose of script: To check the model results and compare them to climate

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")
source("fun_ampphi.R")
theme_set(theme_classic() + theme(strip.background = element_blank()))
```

# Read nasapower data 
```{r}
all_nasapower <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$processed}/03_stu_climate/stu_nasapower.rds")) %>%
  filter(week != 53) %>%
  mutate(pi_week = week * (2*pi/52),
         llid = str_replace_all(llid, " ", "_"))

saveRDS(all_nasapower, glue("{dirs$outputs}/climfit/all_nasapower.rds"))
```

# Plot some 
```{r}
all_nasapower %>%
  filter(clim == "clim_t2m", llid %in% unique(all_clim$llid)[1:160]) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = value_norm, color = paste0(lon,lat))) +
  geom_line() + 
  facet_wrap(study+country~.) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

# Run 1 model for 1 llid
```{r}
length(unique(all_nasapower$llid))
dat <- all_nasapower %>%
  filter(llid == unique(all_nasapower$llid)[1])

mod_l <- sapply(unique(dat$clim)[1], function(x) {
  brm(value_norm ~ cos(pi_week) + sin(pi_week), data = filter(dat, clim == x))
}, simplify = FALSE)

mod_l[[1]]
```

# Check fit 
```{r}
filter(dat, clim == "clim_rh2m") %>%
  mutate(dat = "data") %>%
  bind_rows(filter(dat, clim == "clim_rh2m") %>%
              mutate(dat = "prediction",
                     value_norm = posterior_predict(mod_l[[1]], ndraws = 1)[1,])) %>%
  bind_rows(conditional_effects(mod_l[[1]], effects = c("pi_week"))$`pi_week` %>%
              mutate(value_norm = estimate__, dat = "mod")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = pi_week, y = value_norm, color = dat, fill = dat)) + 
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__), alpha = 0.1, color = "transparent") + 
  geom_line() + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "grey", "orange")) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("black", "grey", "orange"))
```




















# Run a model per clim, study and country 
```{r}
mod_l <- list()
for(clim_name in c("clim_t2m")) {
  mod_l[[clim_name]] <- sapply(unique(datselclim$study_country), function(x) {
    pomp::bake(glue("{dirs$outputs}/clim_models/brm_{clim_name}_{x}.rds"), dir = "", {
      brm(value ~ cos(pi_week) + sin(pi_week), 
          data = filter(datselclim, clim == clim_name, study_country == x))
    })
  }, simplify = FALSE)
}
```

# Get cofficients and Rhats
```{r}
# Get coefficients
coef <- lapply(mod_l$clim_t2m, recursive = FALSE, summary)

# Get Rhats
rhats <- lapply(coef, function(x) {
  bind_rows(x$fixed, x$spec_pars, x$random$`study:country`) %>%
    rownames_to_column("coefficient") }) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "mod") %>%
  mutate(pat = str_remove(mod, "\\..*"),
         clim = str_remove(mod, "^[^.]*\\.")) %>%
  group_by(mod) %>%
  filter(Rhat == max(Rhat)) %>%
  mutate(Rhat = round(Rhat, digits = 1),
         Rhat_cond = Rhat == 1)

rhats %>%
  filter(Rhat_cond == FALSE)
```

# Get amplitude and phase and plot it
```{r}
all_coefcosine <- sapply(coef, function(x) rownames_to_column(x$fixed, var = "parameter"), 
                         simplify = FALSE) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "study_country") %>%
  mutate(clim = "clim_t2m") %>%
  left_join(distinct(datselclim, clim, study_country, study, country, reg_6),
            by = join_by(study_country, clim), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  # Define parameter type (int, p_cos, p_sin)
  mutate(param = case_when(str_detect(parameter, "cos") ~ "p_cos",
                    str_detect(parameter, "sin") ~ "p_sin",
                    .default = "int")) %>%
  select(clim, study_country, study, country, param, Estimate, reg_6) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = param, values_from = Estimate) %>% 
  # Estimate amplitude and phase -----------------------------------------------------------------
  mutate(amp = fun_amp_ls(p_cos = p_cos, p_sin = p_sin, mu = int),
         phi = fun_phi(p_cos = p_cos, p_sin = p_sin, phi_type = "week")) 

filter(datselclim, clim == "clim_t2m") %>%
  distinct(pat, study, country, reg_6, tot, tot_per, study_country) %>%
  left_join(all_coefcosine) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = phi, y = reg_6, size = tot_per, color = pat)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) + 
filter(datselclim, clim == "clim_t2m") %>%
  distinct(pat, study, country, reg_6, tot, tot_per, study_country) %>%
  left_join(all_coefcosine) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = amp, y = reg_6, size = tot_per, color = pat)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) + 
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log2")

filter(datselclim, clim == "clim_t2m", study_country == "105910_Russia") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = pi_week, y = value)) + 
  geom_line() 
```

# Prepare data for the plot climate+immunogenicity results 
```{r}
datpl1_sam <- datpl_sam %>%
  filter(sam_no <= 100) %>%
  rename(week = "vac_week_v1", value_norm = sam_estimate) %>%
  mutate(clim = "1imm", 
         tot_per = 1) %>%
  select(sam_no, pat, pat_tidy, clu, week, tot, tot_per, clim, value_norm, phi_mean, phi_mean_shift, checkgaps_all) 

datpl1_samrug <- distinct(datpl1_sam, week, tot, tot_per, clu, pat, pat_tidy, phi_mean, phi_mean_shift) %>%
  mutate(week = case_when(!is.na(tot) ~ week)) %>%
  mutate(pat_tidy = reorder(as.character(pat_tidy), phi_mean_shift))

datpl1_clim <- datselclim %>%
  rename("clu" = "reg_6") %>%
  select(pat, clu, week, tot_per, clim, value_norm, lat_med, lon_med) %>%
  mutate(clu = str_remove_all(clu, " ")) %>%
  filter(clim %in% c("clim_rh2m", "clim_t2m", "clim_t2mdew")) %>%
  left_join(distinct(datpl1_sam, pat, clu, pat_tidy, phi_mean_shift, checkgaps_all), by = join_by(pat, clu)) %>%
  filter(checkgaps_all == FALSE)
```

# Plot climate+immunogenicity results 
```{r}
plclu_l <- list()
for(i in unique(datpl1_sam$clu)) {
  plclu_l[[i]] <- bind_rows(datpl1_sam, datpl1_clim) %>%
    mutate(pat_tidy = reorder(pat_tidy, phi_mean_shift)) %>%
    filter(clu == i) %>%
    mutate(pat_tidy = droplevels(pat_tidy)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = week, y = value_norm, color = phi_mean, alpha = tot_per,
               group = paste0(sam_no, lat_med, lon_med))) + 
    geom_line() + 
    geom_point(data = filter(datpl1_samrug, clu == i) %>%
                 mutate(pat_tidy = droplevels(pat_tidy)), 
               aes(y = -Inf), group = 1, shape = "|", size = 3, color = "black") +
    scale_x_continuous("Week", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(1,52), expand = c(0,0)) + 
    scale_y_continuous("Value", expand = c(0.2,0)) + 
    scale_color_gradientn("Peak timing", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(0,52), na.value = "black",
                          colours = c(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "C"), 
                                      rev(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "C")))) +
    ggh4x::facet_nested_wrap(~pat_tidy+clim, scales = "free_y", nest_line = TRUE,
                             solo_line = TRUE, ncol = 8) +
    theme(legend.position = "top") +
    ggtitle(i)
  # Find number of pathogens
  npat <- ceiling(length(unique(filter(datpl1_samrug, clu == i)$pat))/2)
  # Save the plot 
  ggsave(plclu_l[[i]], width = 10, height = 2 + npat*1.2, file = paste0("../figures/clim/", i, "_reg_6.pdf"))
}

plclu_l
```

# Run models per pathogen 
```{r}
mod_l <- list()
for(pat_name in unique(datselclim$pat)) {
  mod_l[[pat_name]] <- sapply(c("clim_t2m", "clim_rh2m", "clim_cloud_amt"), function(x) {
    # Check # study:country
    n_sc <- max((filter(datselclim, clim == x, pat == pat_name) %>%
      distinct(study, country, reg_6) %>%
      group_by(reg_6) %>%
      summarise(tot = n()))$tot)
    # If only one study:country
    if(n_sc == 1) {
      pomp::bake(glue("{dirs$outputs}/clim_models/brm_{pat_name}_{x}.rds"), dir = "", {
        brm(value ~ cos(pi_week)*reg_6 + sin(pi_week)*reg_6, 
          data = filter(datselclim, clim == x, pat == pat_name))
      })
    } else if (n_sc > 1) {
    # If more than one study:country
    pomp::bake(glue("{dirs$outputs}/clim_models/brm_{pat_name}_{x}.rds"), dir = "", {
      brm(value ~ cos(pi_week)*reg_6 + sin(pi_week)*reg_6 + (1|study:country), 
        data = filter(datselclim, clim == x, pat == pat_name))
    })
    }
  }, simplify = FALSE)
}

# Get coefficients
coef <- lapply(unlist(mod_l, recursive = FALSE), summary)

# Get Rhats
rhats <- lapply(coef, function(x) {
  bind_rows(x$fixed, x$spec_pars, x$random$`study:country`) %>%
    rownames_to_column("coefficient") }) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "mod") %>%
  mutate(pat = str_remove(mod, "\\..*"),
         clim = str_remove(mod, "^[^.]*\\.")) %>%
  group_by(mod) %>%
  filter(Rhat == max(Rhat)) %>%
  mutate(Rhat = round(Rhat, digits = 1),
         Rhat_cond = Rhat == 1)

rhats %>%
  filter(Rhat_cond == FALSE)
```
